place.name: Boynton Beach Community High School
place.description: Boynton Beach Community High School is a public high school located in Boynton Beach, Florida, United States, and it serves grades 9–12 in the School District of Palm Beach County. Boynton Beach High school has been rated a "C" for the year 2017–2018 by the Florida Department of Education and School District of Palm Beach County.
